📢 In Preparation for the Upcoming Rabies Awareness Month 2026
​"Awareness Training on Safety Measures in Handling of Suspected Rabid Dogs or Cats"
​The Cabanatuan City Veterinary Office successfully conducted an orientation on proper specimen handling for animals suspected of rabies that died before completing the mandatory 14-day observation period.
​The activity was held in San Juan Acffa and focused on the correct procedures for collecting and preparing specimens for the ICT Rapid Rabies Test, ensuring accurate and timely laboratory results.
​This orientation aims to:
​✅ Strengthen proper reporting and response to suspected rabies cases.
​✅ Ensure safe and correct specimen handling to protect handlers.
​✅ Enhance coordination between barangay officials and veterinary personnel.
​✅ Protect the community from rabies through early detection and rapid testing.
​🐕 Rabies prevention is a shared responsibility. > Through continuous education and adherence to proper protocols, we move closer to a safer and rabies-free Cabanatuan City! 🏙️

Today is the 128th Birth Anniversary of 𝙇𝙖𝙯𝙖𝙧𝙤 𝘼. 𝙁𝙧𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙞𝙨𝙘𝙤, 𝙉𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙖𝙡 𝘼𝙧𝙩𝙞𝙨𝙩 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙇𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙧𝙖𝙩𝙪𝙧𝙚.

February 22 1898, Lazaro A. Francisco "Ka Saro" was a Filipino novelist, essayist and playwright. Born in Orani, Province of Bataan. At the age of 16, he eventually migrated to and permanently resided, spent his childhood years here in our city.

Lazaro Francisco is recognized for his significant contributions to the social realist tradition in Philippine literature. His novels reflect a deep commitment to nationalism, showcasing his dedication to the cultural identity of the Philippines. Francisco rose to prominence not only due to his unwavering social principles but also because of his exceptional command of the Tagalog language and his fluid prose style.

May his legacy of social justice and love for the Filipino language continue to inspire us. Let us honor him by appreciating and sharing his invaluable works in Philippine literature.

HUWAG MAGING BIKTIMA NG MGA UNRECORDED ONLINE LENDING PLATFORMS

Ipinapaalala ng Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) sa publiko na ang mga Online Lending Platforms (OLPs), mobile applications, at websites na nakalista sa ibaba ay HINDI awtorisado at HINDI pinahihintulutang mag-alok, magproseso, o magpautang ng anumang loan products sa pamamagitan ng Google Play Store, Apple App Store, o mga websites.

Ang mga nabanggit na OLPs ay lumalabag sa SEC Memorandum Circular (MC) No. 10, Series of 2021, na nagpatupad ng moratorium o pansamantalang pagtigil sa paglulunsad, paggamit, at pagpapatakbo ng mga bagong Online Lending Platforms, na epektibo simula 02 Nobyembre 2021.

Ang pagpapatuloy ng mga nabanggit na OLPs na magpautang nang walang otorisasyon ay itinuturing na paglabag sa umiiral na mga regulasyon ng SEC at maaaring magresulta sa pagpataw ng administrative sanctions, kabilang ang cease and desist orders, permanent closure, blacklisting, at pag-file ng kaukulang kaso.

Ang tanging legal at awtorisadong OLPs ay makikita sa opisyal na listahan sa:
SEC Website (List of Recorded Online Lending Platforms): https://www.sec.gov.ph/lending-companies-and-financing-companies-2/list-of-recorded-online-lending-platforms

Basahin ang kabuuang advisory mula sa SEC website: https://www.sec.gov.ph/advisories-2026/advisory-re-unrecorded-online-lending-platforms-2/#gsc.tab=0 

Para sa katanungan, reklamo, o pag-report sa mga ilegal na nagpapautang, mangyaring makipag-ugnayan sa SEC Financing and Lending Companies Department o tumawag sa kanilang mga numero na (02) 8818-5990 o 09296263095 o di kaya ay magpadala ng mensahe sa SEC iMessage Portal sa imessage.sec.gov.ph.
